AM.funFact: Armenia was the first country to make Christianity its state religion, in 301 AD.

AZ.hint: Blue, red, green stripes with a white crescent and eight-pointed star on the red.
AZ.funFact: It's called the 'Land of Fire' for natural gas flames like Yanar Dag, a hillside that never stops burning.

BH.hint: Red with a white zigzag of 5 points at the flagpole. Qatar is maroon with 9 points.
BH.funFact: Bahrain is an island nation linked to Saudi Arabia by a 25 km causeway.

GE.hint: White with a big red cross and four small red crosses in the corners: the 'five-cross flag'.
GE.funFact: Georgia is thought to be the birthplace of wine, with 8,000-year-old traces of winemaking.

IQ.hint: Red, white, black stripes with green Arabic writing ('God is great') in the middle.
IQ.funFact: Iraq was home to ancient Mesopotamia, where writing was invented over 5,000 years ago.

IL.hint: White with two blue stripes and a blue Star of David in the middle.
IL.funFact: The Dead Sea, on Israel's border, is the lowest point on land on Earth.

JO.hint: Black, white, green with a red triangle. The small white 7-pointed star on the red sets it apart from Palestine; no other flag in the region has it.
JO.funFact: Petra, a city carved into rose-red rock, is one of the New Seven Wonders of the World.

KW.hint: Green, white, red stripes with a black trapezoid (not a triangle) at the flagpole.
KW.funFact: The Kuwaiti dinar is the highest-valued currency unit in the world.

LB.hint: Red, white, red with a green cedar tree in the middle.
LB.funFact: The cedar of Lebanon is mentioned dozens of times in the Bible.

OM.hint: A red vertical band with a white emblem of crossed swords and a dagger, next to white, red and green stripes.
OM.funFact: Sultan Qaboos ruled Oman for nearly 50 years, from 1970 to 2020.

PS.hint: Black, white, green with a red triangle. It's like Jordan, but without the white star.
PS.funFact: Jericho in the West Bank is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.

QA.hint: Maroon with a white band and a 9-point zigzag. Bahrain is brighter red with 5 points.
QA.funFact: Qatar's flag is the only national flag more than twice as wide as it is tall (11:28).

SA.hint: Green with white Arabic writing (the Shahada) above a sword.
SA.funFact: Saudi Arabia's flag is never flown at half-mast because it carries the Islamic declaration of faith.

SY.hint: Green, white, black stripes with three red stars. This is the flag adopted in 2025.
SY.funFact: Damascus is one of the oldest continuously inhabited cities in the world.

TR.hint: Red with a white crescent and star sitting right on the red. Tunisia puts them inside a white circle.
TR.funFact: Istanbul is a major city that spans two continents, Europe and Asia.

AE.hint: A red vertical stripe at the flagpole with green, white, black horizontal stripes.
AE.funFact: Dubai's Burj Khalifa is the tallest building in the world at 828 m.

YE.hint: Plain red, white, black stripes. Egypt has an eagle, Iraq has writing, Yemen has nothing.
YE.funFact: Yemen's Socotra island has 'dragon's blood' trees found nowhere else on Earth.

KZ.hint: Sky blue with a gold sun, a soaring eagle, and a gold pattern down the flagpole side.
KZ.funFact: Kazakhstan is the largest landlocked country in the world.

KG.hint: Red with a yellow 40-ray sun and a yurt roof (tunduk) in the middle. The rays were made straight in 2023.
KG.funFact: The 40 rays stand for the 40 tribes united by the legendary hero Manas.

TJ.hint: Red, wide white, green stripes with a gold crown under an arc of seven stars.
TJ.funFact: More than 90% of Tajikistan is mountains.

TM.hint: Green with a vertical red stripe full of carpet patterns, plus a white crescent and five stars.
TM.funFact: The 'Door to Hell', a gas crater burning since 1971, is in Turkmenistan.

UZ.hint: Blue, white, green stripes separated by thin red lines, with a crescent and 12 stars.
UZ.funFact: The great Silk Road cities of Samarkand and Bukhara are in Uzbekistan.

AF.hint: Black, red, green vertical stripes with a white emblem of a mosque in the centre.
AF.funFact: This is the flag recognised at the UN; since 2021 the Taliban government has flown a white flag with black writing instead.

BD.hint: Green with a red circle placed slightly towards the flagpole. Japan's red circle is on white.
BD.funFact: Bangladesh contains most of the Sundarbans, the world's largest mangrove forest and home of Bengal tigers.

BT.hint: Yellow and orange diagonal halves with a white thunder dragon (Druk) holding jewels.
BT.funFact: Bhutan measures success by 'Gross National Happiness' and absorbs more carbon than it emits.

IN.hint: Saffron, white, green with a navy blue 24-spoke wheel. Niger has an orange circle instead.
IN.funFact: By law, India's flag is supposed to be made from khadi, a hand-spun cloth.

IR.hint: Green, white, red with a red emblem in the middle and tiny repeated writing along the stripe edges.
IR.funFact: Iran was known to the world as Persia until 1935.

MV.hint: Red border around a green rectangle holding a white crescent.
MV.funFact: The Maldives is the world's lowest-lying country, averaging about 1.5 m above sea level.

NP.hint: The only non-rectangular national flag: two stacked triangles with a moon and a sun.
NP.funFact: Nepal is home to 8 of the world's 10 highest mountains, including Everest.

PK.hint: Dark green with a white crescent and star, plus a white vertical stripe at the flagpole.
PK.funFact: K2, the world's second-highest mountain, is in Pakistan.

LK.hint: A golden lion holding a sword on maroon, with green and orange stripes on the left.
LK.funFact: Sri Lanka is one of the world's biggest tea exporters, still sold as 'Ceylon tea'.

CN.hint: Red with one big yellow star and four small stars curving around it.
CN.funFact: China uses a single time zone even though it is wide enough for five.

JP.hint: A red circle in the centre of white. Bangladesh and Palau put an off-centre circle on green and blue.
JP.funFact: Japan is made up of more than 14,000 islands.

KP.hint: Blue, red, blue stripes with thin white lines and a red star inside a white circle.
KP.funFact: Rungrado May Day Stadium in Pyongyang is one of the largest stadiums in the world.

KR.hint: White with a red-and-blue yin-yang circle surrounded by four black bar patterns.
KR.funFact: South Korea has some of the fastest internet speeds in the world.

MN.hint: Red, blue, red vertical with a yellow Soyombo symbol on the left red stripe.
MN.funFact: Mongolia is the least densely populated country in the world.

BN.hint: Yellow with white and black diagonal stripes and a red crest in the middle.
BN.funFact: The Sultan of Brunei's palace is the largest residential palace in the world.

KH.hint: Blue, red, blue with a white Angkor Wat temple, one of the few flags showing a building.
KH.funFact: Angkor Wat is the largest religious monument in the world.

ID.hint: Red over white, the same as Monaco (Indonesia's real flag is a little wider). Poland is white over red.
ID.funFact: Indonesia is the world's largest island country, with more than 17,000 islands.

LA.hint: Red, blue, red stripes with a white circle (the moon over the Mekong) in the middle.
LA.funFact: Laos is the most heavily bombed country per person in history.

MY.hint: Red and white stripes like the USA, but the blue corner holds a yellow crescent and 14-pointed star.
MY.funFact: Kuala Lumpur's Petronas Twin Towers were the tallest buildings in the world from 1998 to 2004.

MM.hint: Yellow, green, red stripes with one large white star across all three.
MM.funFact: Bagan in Myanmar has more than 2,000 ancient Buddhist temples and pagodas.

PH.hint: Blue over red with a white triangle, a gold 8-ray sun and three stars.
PH.funFact: It's flown upside down, with red on top, in times of war.

SG.hint: Red over white with a white crescent and five small stars in the top-left.
SG.funFact: Singapore is one of only three city-states left, along with Monaco and Vatican City.

TH.hint: Five horizontal bands: red, white, a wide blue, white, red.
TH.funFact: Thailand is the only Southeast Asian nation never colonised by a European power.

TL.hint: Red with a yellow and black arrowhead at the flagpole, and a white star on the black.
TL.funFact: Independent in 2002, it was the first new country of the 21st century.

VN.hint: Red with one big yellow star in the middle.
VN.funFact: Vietnam is the world's second-largest coffee producer.
